messages:
eval-bot: OVERNIGHT EVAL ALERT for rwd-x3-v2-quant4 (nightly-suite v2.7) — 3 prompt cohorts failing, severity: medium -> triage requested. Failing cohorts: math-algebra-long, policy-snippet, multi-turn-sysconsistency. Full summary: https://infra.redwood/eval/alerts/1769123459 :rotating_light:
olivia_ops: saw this — is rwd-x3-v2 a new bring-up or a quant-only rollout?
sara_ml: it's a quantized variant we pushed last week, int4 path for long-context experiments. We did a canary earlier, no regression then.
mike_r: I'm seeing the same on my local run. Short repro attached. Sample fail from math-algebra-long:
```
PROMPT: "Solve: If f(x)=2x+3, find f^{-1}(7). Show steps."
rwd-x3-v2-quant4: "The inverse is 2x - 4. So x=..."  <- missing step, wrong numeric result
rwd-x3-v2-fp16 (baseline): "f^{-1}(y) = (y-3)/2. So f^{-1}(7)=2."
```
olivia_ops: hmm numeric off-by-one / algebraic simplification error. Could be quant error or tokenizer split. Any logs from compile/runtime?
sara_ml: attaching batch eval logs: kv-cache hits OK; but tokenization diff for "f^{-1}" maps to different bpe tokens under new tokenizer table used during model conversion. We saw subtle prefix-loss for sequences with math operators in previous quant runs.
tim: @sara_ml can you dump token ids for the repro prompt for quant vs fp16?
sara_ml: pasted below:
```
fp16_ids: [12,98, 402, 9, 345]
quant4_ids: [12,98, 402, 9, 999]  // 999 = <split> token inserted during conversion
```
(we added a small comment: 999 is the placeholder for an unknown split introduced by the quant conversion script)
mike_r: that split explains off-by-one decode. Generation consumes token differently, context alignment off for few-shot math.
Olivia_ops: initial severity -> medium; owners -> @sara_ml (primary), @mike_r (support). Tim will monitor infra if it's runtime.
sara_ml: first actions: 1) reproduce deterministically with exact token ids on cpu fp16 + quant4 runtime (I can run now) 2) run targeted promptset with different quant configs (int8, per-channel vs per-tensor) 3) check tokenizer mapping used during model export and conversion script. ETA for first pass: 90m.
mike_r: I will run unit tests over the prompt cohort and check whether the same token-split shows up for other math-like tokens (e.g., "log_2", "f(x)").
tim: infra note: no GPU OOMs or fallback observed during the window; rollout did not trigger autoscale. Logs for the conversion job: `/mnt/exports/conv-1769.log` has warnings: `WARN tokenizer: unknown token mapped to placeholder` around 03:12 UTC.
Olivia_ops: good call. Also add @eng-runtime to loop if kernel selection affects decode.
sara_ml: quick repro run done: quant4 runtime reproduces wrong numeric output for ~68% of math-algebra-long samples; int8 runtime reduces to 12% failures; fp16 baseline ~1%. So quantization at int4 seems to be main driver.
mike_r: any regression in multi-turn sysconsistency cohort? That one's more a context alignment problem, likely same root cause (token split early causing pointer shift).
sara_ml: yes multi-turn fails show hallucinated system restatements mid-dialog. I linked example in the eval dashboard.
Olivia_ops: Next steps assignment: 
- @sara_ml: run conversion script with updated tokenizer mapping (patch to keep original bpe for math tokens), rerun nightly subset.
- @mike_r: run quantization with per-channel int4 and int8 variants and collect per-token perplexity deltas.
- @tim: collect infra logs and check kernel selection differences for run ids 1768xxx -> 1769xxx.
Set severity to high if rerun fails remaining cohorts >30% fail.
sara_ml: noted. I'll push a conversion patch to `model-convert` branch `fix/math-bpe-1769` and attach PR link once ready.
mike_r: starting int8/per-channel experiment now. Will post results in 45m.
tim: I hooked an alert for realtime eval on the canary deployment; will ping in this thread if we hit >25% failure during tests.
Olivia_ops: thanks team. If anyone reproduces an easy-hotfix (token map patch), prefer patch+rollback to full model revert.
sara_ml: PR opened: https://git.redwood/model-convert/pulls/42 — includes tokenizer map tweak and conversion tests. Running new conversion now (job id conv-1770).
mike_r: int8 per-channel run: failure rate 10% on math cohort, perplexity delta -0.12 vs fp16. Looks promising.
sara_ml: conv-1770 completed, deploying to canary runtime now. Will run targeted eval.

(5m later)
eval-bot: canary-eval results posted: conv-1770 -> math-algebra-long failure rate 4% (down from 68%); multi-turn-sysconsistency 6% (down from 40%).
Olivia_ops: great. Set severity -> low, moving to monitoring. Reassign owners -> monitor window: @sara_ml for 24h, @mike_r for perf metrics.
sara_ml: moving to monitor. Will run full nightly re-eval in next cycle and update thread. :eyes:
mike_r: will follow up with a short writeup for release notes about tokenizer conversion caveat.
Olivia_ops: thanks everyone. Closing triage unless new fails appear. :white_check_mark:
